overrides.mechanism: After the 2025-12-31 member 'Titan BW Borrower' was given its printed name 'Titan BW Borrower L.P.', the matcher paired the 2025-12-31 One stop 1 line (par 16,104, SF + 5.38) with the 2026-03-31 One stop 3 line (par 829, SF + 4.75). The end side is moved to the 2026-03-31 One stop 1 line (par 16,582, SF + 5.38), which continues it.
overrides.residual_risk: Natural key (name, date, FV within 1 pct or 1,000); the three Titan rows per quarter have distinct fair values. The 829 line (2026-03-31 c-101) is left without a 2025-12-31 predecessor (it was a new tranche at 4.75).
